record.paper_title: Open questions on prominences from coordinated observations by IRIS, Hinode, SDO/AIA, THEMIS, and the Meudon/MSDP
record.original_question: For a solar filament, is the associated magnetic flux rope brought upward through the photosphere by a levitation process, or is that flux rope instead created by successive reconnections between magnetic field lines?

evidence.quote: Does the flux rope corresponding to a filament lift up through the photosphere by levitation process (Okamoto et al. 2008) or is it formed by successive reconnections between magnetic field lines (van Ballegooijen & Martens 1989; Schmieder et al. 2006)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A solar filament is a cool, dense plasma structure suspended in the solar corona along a magnetic polarity inversion line, supported against gravity by an underlying magnetic flux rope (a bundle of helically twisted magnetic field lines). Two competing scenarios have been proposed for how this flux rope comes into existence:

(L) Levitation scenario: a pre-formed, coherent twisted flux rope is bodily transported upward across the photosphere from the convection zone into the corona by an emergence/levitation process.

(R) Reconnection scenario: no coherent flux rope crosses the photosphere; instead, an initially sheared magnetic arcade in the corona is gradually transformed into a twisted flux rope through a sequence of magnetic reconnections between neighboring field lines, driven by photospheric shearing and converging flows.

Determine which of (L) or (R) is the correct mechanism by which the magnetic flux rope associated with a solar filament is formed, or characterize the conditions under which each mechanism operates.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent solar physics literature (through 2022–2026) continues to treat the origin of filament-supporting flux ropes as an open question, with both photospheric emergence/levitation and coronal reconnection-based formation actively studied. Modern reviews and simulations suggest the two mechanisms may be complementary rather than mutually exclusive, but no consensus single mechanism has been established observationally.

status_evidence.title: The Formation of Solar Prominences: Plasma Origin and Mechanisms
status_evidence.snippet: Open questions and future directions in connecting multi-scale physical processes to the observed diversity of prominence behaviors are highlighted.
status_evidence.claim: Filament/prominence formation mechanisms remain an active open research area as of 2025.

status_evidence.title: On-Disc Observations of Flux Rope Formation Prior to Its Eruption
status_evidence.snippet: Tether-cutting reconnection can convert sheared field into a twisted flux rope... framework accommodates both flux-rope and sheared-arcade scenarios.
status_evidence.claim: Both reconnection-based and pre-existing flux rope scenarios are still considered viable.

status_evidence.title: The influence of flux rope heating models on solar prominence formation
status_evidence.snippet: levitation-condensation model... sheared magnetic arcade eventually changes internal connectivity via magnetic reconnection and builds a twisted, helical field.
status_evidence.claim: Levitation and reconnection are intertwined in current models, indicating no settled answer.
